event.title: Hunter Biden Reports Worsening Condition of Joe Biden's Cancer
event.canonical_title: Hunter Biden Reports Worsening Condition of Joe Biden's Cancer
event.summary: Hunter Biden has revealed that his father's prostate cancer has worsened, stating it has metastasized into his bones and is causing significant pain. He described the situation as 'very debilitating' and expressed the emotional toll it takes on the family during a recent interview.

timeline.title: Hunter Biden Reports Worsening Condition of Joe Biden's Cancer
timeline.summary: Hunter Biden has stated that his father, former President Joe Biden, is experiencing a worsening condition due to cancer that has spread further. In a recent interview, he described the situation as 'very debilitating' and expressed emotional distress over witnessing his father's pain.
key_facts: Hunter Biden reported that Joe Biden's cancer has metastasized.
He described his father's condition as very debilitating and painful.
